description: This file defines classes, functions, and enums related to notification forwarding policies within an Android application. It includes configuration data classes, filtering modes, time-based quiet hours checking, and burst limiting for notifications.

classes.name: NotificationPackageFilterMode
classes.description: Enum class representing filter modes for notification packages: allowlist or blocklist.

classes.name: NotificationForwardingPolicy
classes.description: Data class encapsulating various notification forwarding policies including enabled status, filter mode, package set, quiet hours, and session key.

classes.name: NotificationBurstLimiter
classes.description: Class for limiting the number of notification events allowed within a minute, with thread-safe allowance checks.

methods.name: fromRawValue
methods.description: Converts a raw string to a NotificationPackageFilterMode enum value.

methods.name: allowsPackage
methods.description: Checks if a given package is allowed based on the current filter mode and packages list.

methods.name: isWithinQuietHours
methods.description: Determines if the current time is within the configured quiet hours.

methods.name: normalizeLocalHourMinute
methods.description: Normalizes a string representing a time in HH:MM format, validating and standardizing it.

methods.name: parseLocalHourMinute
methods.description: Parses a time string into total minutes from midnight.

methods.name: allow
methods.description: Checks if a notification event at a given timestamp is permitted based on the burst limit.
